policy.nonempty_refs: Every nonempty measurement/output must resolve against unique compatible exact identities from source model plus explicitly supplied ACTIVE CSV controllers. No aliasing, no partial-valid associations. Validate before writes.
policy.rejected: Exclude rejected controller/endpoint rows before active CSV endpoint resolution; neither known rejected source IDs nor excluded CSV controllers may be resurrected through another row. Report exclusions; preserve original source/reason separately.
policy.native_existing_conflicts: Existing Native source endpoint conflict remains refusal; CSV does not overwrite existing record.
policy.missing_fields: Required CSV columns stay required; individual empty endpoint cells are unknown and allowed when existing matching/admission rules allow the row.
policy.legacy: Only new Native-unplaced route uses new strict exact-reference policy; placed/twin legacy behavior and outputs remain unchanged.
policy.graph_boundary: Valid supplemental CSV controller may be absent from original model graph; retain explicit boundary, require authored/reviewed model addition before full graph/context handoff.

chronology: Appends root-selected policy after v3 static and before v4/candidate calls; previous undecided NL06/NL07 retained in earlier frozen file. NL08/NL09 are newly exposed source-policy positives, not blind trials.
